subject: general
question:
Five friends P, Q, R, S and T are compared on the basis of their height (not necessarily in the same order). Height of T is between P and Q. T is taller than S. R's height is more than P and T.

Which of the following sequence of their height cannot be possible?

I. R > P > T > Q > S

II. R > S > Q > T > P

III. Q > R > T > S > P
solution:
According to the given statements we have:

1) Five friends P, Q, R, S and T are compared on the basis of their height (not necessarily in the same order). Height of T is between P and Q. 

P > T > Q or Q > T > P

2) T is taller than S. 

T > S

3) R's height is more than P and T.

R > P, T
